scope: All published local landing pages in city-data.json; county hub excluded

method.primary: Percent of main-content word positions belonging to an exact eight-word phrase also present on at least one OTHER local page. Word-weighted across the fixed corpus; overlapping matches count each word once. Excludes navigation, footer, scripts, styles, shared credential labels and CTA button text.
method.secondary: Same repeated-word measure on all visible page text, including navigation and footer.
method.pairwise: Eight-word set Jaccard intersection/union across every pair
method.caveat: Local text-overlap audit, not a Siteliner score, plagiarism score or a Google ranking/quality measurement.

exact_paragraphs.method: Paragraphs within main only; excludes navigation, header, footer, scripts and styles. HTML entities decoded, whitespace collapsed and text lowercased; all source city names and Ventura/Los Angeles County labels normalized. Counts paragraph words recurring on at least the minimum number of distinct pages, not similar prose.
exact_paragraphs.caveat: A source-text comparison, not a Google quality or ranking score. Low repetition alone does not establish local usefulness or verify clinical claims.
